topic.source_contract: Mandatory biodiversity net gain, register, legal-agreement and statutory-credit evidence

facts.objective: at least 10 percent biodiversity gain where mandatory
facts.guard: planning permission or metric alone is not delivered gain
future exemption must not be applied before its effective date

facts.legal_security: section 106 or conservation covenant for at least 30 years
facts.guard: registration application is not accepted registration or allocation
register entry is not proof that habitat outcomes were delivered

facts.role: last resort after on-site and off-site options
facts.guard: credit route is not planning consent or completed compensation

scope_guards: Mandatory BNG, exemptions and NSIP commencement dates must be checked against the application date.
The 0.2 hectare and temporary-development exemptions effective 6 August 2026 are not applied early.
The biodiversity metric is a calculation tool and not ecological survey, planning permission or delivered habitat.
A Biodiversity Gain Plan must be approved before commencement where the statutory condition applies.
On-site, registered off-site and statutory-credit routes remain distinct and follow the mitigation hierarchy.
A gain-site register entry or allocation is not proof of habitat creation, management or monitoring success.
A section 106 agreement or conservation covenant secures obligations but does not prove delivery.
No score or promotion is written without exact application scope, metric, gain plan, legal security, allocation and monitoring evidence.
